title: iris lactea f. chrysantha
intro: Iris lactea f. chrysantha, commonly known as the Golden Iris, is a species of flowering plant in the iris family. It is a type of flowering bulbous perennial plant that is known for its beautiful golden-yellow flowers and sword-shaped leaves. The Golden Iris is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
